Tom successfully convinced many people that he possessed paranormal powers.

parishioners.text: The priest assembled the parishioners in the church.

paw.text: Tom's dog left muddy paw prints all over his new carpet.

parmesan.text: Spaghetti is best eaten with some grated Parmesan cheese.

patents.text: The jury found that Samsung had infringed upon Apple's patents.

partitioned.text: The hall could seat a thousand people before it was partitioned.

patočka.text: I'm Josef Patočka and I work at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

pastures.text: Tom left Boston in pursuit of greener pastures and never looked back.

palpitations.text: Have you recently experienced palpitations or felt like your heart was racing?

paleontology.text: The terms are used in geology, paleontology, geophysics, astronomy and physical cosmology.
